title: Implement architecture review fixes for OpenAI/Codex search
description: Fix all findings from the architecture review: separate/align Codex search protocol, registry model selection, research phase budgets, timeout classification, strict response parsing, citation alignment, current OpenAI web-search controls, citation positions, and remove or implement dead find contract.

logs.msg: Implemented separate Codex alpha/search adapter with official request/response mapping, removed Codex branch from OpenAI Responses adapter, added current native controls and citation positions, fixed timeout classification and research fetch continuation/deduplication, updated docs and offline tests. bun run check passes (208 tests). Credentialed live smoke remains unrun.
